sample_points_from_meshes_basic: sample points from a batch of PyTorch3D meshes and return point cloud coordinates
sample_points_from_meshes_with_normals: sample points from meshes and return both coordinates and surface normals for each point
sample_points_from_meshes_with_textures: sample points from textured meshes and return coordinates plus texture values for each point
sample_points_from_meshes_all_outputs: sample points from meshes returning coordinates, normals, and textures in a single call
rand_barycentric_coords_helper: generate random barycentric coordinates uniformly distributed over a triangle for mesh sampling
